comment: Keys, values and messages of the Core 2 deck editor rules (WP-18, docs/design/11): rules/core2Deck.json, the settings the editor reads, the deck-training / card-pools / gear profile fields the copy limit reads, and the run fields an edit touches.

keySets.name: Core2DeckKeys
keySets.doc: Keys the Core 2 deck rules read and write: rules/core2Deck.json, the editor settings, the deck-training profile module and the run and card fields a deck edit touches (web model/deckRules.js, deckCopyLimit.js, engine/kernel/gameConfig.js deckCopyLimit).

keySets.name: Core2DeckValues
keySets.doc: String values the Core 2 deck rules compare or write.

keySets.name: Core2DeckMessages
keySets.doc: Core 2 deck editor messages (the player-facing refusals and the developer-facing errors; {0}.. are string.Format slots).

keys.WholeNumber: {0} must be a whole number of at least {1} (got {2})
keys.MaxBelowMin: Maximum deck size ({0}) is below the minimum ({1}); the editor cannot confirm any deck until one of them moves.
keys.TooFew: Your deck has {0}; it needs at least {1}.
keys.TooMany: Your deck has {0}; it can hold at most {1}.
keys.CopiesWholeNumber: classSpellPowerCopies must be a whole number of at least 1 (got {0})
keys.PoolHasNoCard: $/content/characters/{0}/defaultDeck: pool '{1}' has no card for this character
keys.CannotModify: Deck editing cannot modify an owned card
keys.CannotInvent: Deck editing cannot invent a limited or enhanced card
keys.CannotDelete: Deck editing cannot delete an owned limited card
keys.CopyLimitExceeded: Deck editing exceeds the card copy limit
keys.NeedsConfigured: The deck editor's equipment gate reads a configured game profile
